The Shanghai Times
FRIDAY, JANUARY. 4, 1924.

THE WAR SCARE IN THE
YANGTZE

STRENGTH OF THE TROOPS

In Kiangsu, Anhwei, Chekiang And
Kiangsi; Some Statistics

(From Our Staff Correspondent)

Peking, Dec. 30.
In view of report of possible military hostilities in the Lower Yangtze, the Ministry of War has given for the information of the public an approximate idea of the comparative military strength of the provinces of Kiangsu, Anhwei, Chekiang and Kiangsi.

Chekiang has four army divisions and one mixed brigade.
(1) The 4th Army Division stationed in Hangchow and whose commander is General Chen Lor-shan.
(2) The 16th Army Division in Hangchow and under the direct command of General Lu Yunghsiang, the Tupan of the province.
(3) The 1st Division of Chekiang Army, in Hangchow, and under the command of General Pang Kou-kang.
(4) The 2nd Division of Chekiang Army, in Hangchow, under the command of General Chang Tsai-yang, the Civil Governor of the province.
(5) The 6th Mixed Brigade, in Shanghai, under the command of General Ho Feng-lung, the Defence Commissioner of Shanghai.

Anhwei has five mixed brigades and about one division.

1924年1月4日，星期五。

长江流域的战争恐慌

军队兵力

江苏、安徽、浙江及江西；若干统计数据

（本报特约通讯员）

北京，12月30日。鉴于有关长江下游可能发生军事敌对行动的报道，陆军部向公众提供了江苏、安徽、浙江和江西四省相对军力的概略情况。

浙江拥有四个陆军师和一个混成旅。
(1) 第4陆军师，驻杭州，指挥官为陈乐山将军。
(2) 第16陆军师，驻杭州，由该省督军卢永祥将军直接指挥。
(3) 浙军第1师，驻杭州，指挥官为潘国纲将军。
(4) 浙军第2师，驻杭州，指挥官为该省省长张载阳将军。
(5) 第6混成旅，驻上海，指挥官为上海防守司令何丰林将军。

BRITISH CONSULATE.
NINGPO.

September 29th, 1927.

Dear Mc Euen,

I am most extremely obliged to you for
having taken so much trouble about getting the partic-
ulars of the military changes in Chekiang. There is a
point about which I wonder if you could give me infor-
mation, and that is what is the Division which Ho Feng-
lin has at Lanchua. I rather suspect that it is part of
the Xth Division, which is under Lu Jun Hsiang, but I
would be grateful if you could confirm or correct my
impression.

I can quite appreciate that it must have been a very
great work to go over the whole organisation, and I really
am most appreciative.

yours sincerely

N. J. Hauides. Dan,

K. J. Mc Euen Esquire
Commissioner of Police
Shanghai.
pages.zh:
5303
26/9/23
英国领事馆。
宁波。

1927年9月29日。

亲爱的麦克尤恩：

非常感谢您不辞辛劳地获取浙江军事变动的详情。有一点我想请您提供信息，即何丰林在兰华 (音译) 拥有的是哪个师。我颇怀疑那是隶属于卢永祥的第10师的一部分，但如果您能证实或纠正我的印象，我将不胜感激。

我完全理解梳理整个组织架构必定是一项极其繁重的工作，对此我深表感激。

此致

敬礼

N. J. Hauides. Dan,

K. J. 麦克尤恩 先生
警务处长
上海。

H.B.M. CONSULATE-GENERAL.
SHANGHAI.
September 18, 1927.

My dear McEuen,

    Thank you very much indeed for
the most excellent report on the distribution
of Chinese troops in Kiangsu province which
you sent me this morning.

    I quite realise how difficult it
must have been to compile, and am very grate-
ful. It should be exceedingly useful at the
present time.

                        Yours sincerely,

                        (Signature)

K.J. McEuen, Esquire,
    The Commissioner of Police,
        Shanghai Municipal Council.
